end.summary:
Practised reading and plotting points from ordered pairs.
Identified quadrant II using signs (−, +) in two responses.
Initially said (3, 2) and (2, 3) were the same point, then corrected this by tracing the coordinates in order.
For a point in quadrant II reflected across the y-axis, identified quadrant I.
Teach-back was not passed; plotting (4, 3) was stated but not independently confirmed.
end.parentNote: Harsh practised using the x-coordinate first and then the y-coordinate, and used coordinate signs to identify quadrants. They correctly identified quadrant II as (−, +) and later corrected the mix-up about (3, 2) and (2, 3) by tracing each point in order. At home, ask them to plot a few pairs such as (2, 4) and (4, 2), saying aloud “right/left first, then up/down.”
